findings.issue: Opening profile editing discards an unsaved selection or reordered backup queue without warning. SelectionForm's beforeunload handler does not cover this React state change.
findings.reproduction: Prepare an unsaved selection or reorder backups. Click 'Editar perfil', then return to requests and reopen the review. The unsaved choices are lost.
findings.recommendation: Guard profile navigation when the review is dirty, or preserve the review draft outside the component that is unmounted.

findings.issue: Successful application removes the focused button without moving focus to the result. The status announcement does not preserve keyboard focus as required by the interface specification.
findings.reproduction: Use the keyboard to activate 'Candidatar-se'. On success, its button is replaced by an unfocusable paragraph, leaving no explicit focus destination.
findings.recommendation: Make the result programmatically focusable and focus it after successful application. Verify the next keyboard navigation step in a browser.

findings.issue: The concurrent-call tests do not establish the frozen design's transaction race guarantees. The installed convex-test implementation serializes top-level transactions. This test also checks only final slot membership, without identifying which decline committed first or inspecting intermediate committed snapshots.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the Promise.all race tests and convex-test/dist/index.js: TransactionManager.begin acquires a top-level lock. The tests exercise serialized outcomes without testing overlapping reads, conflict retries, or controlled alternative commit orders.
findings.recommendation: Retain these outcome tests, explicitly label their limits, and add authorized synthetic evidence for both owner-save/response orderings and concurrent promotion with committed-state observations.

findings.issue: T16 injects failure only after decline and promotion have both completed inside a nested mutation. It does not cover the frozen design's failure between decline and promotion, failure after the first selection insert, or successful retry following rollback.
findings.reproduction: Read the sole T16 test: respond completes before the synthetic outer exception, and the test ends after checking rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add controlled synthetic failures at the specified write boundaries for both mutations, verify unchanged offers, queue and revision, then retry and assert exactly one complete transition.

checks.result: Read spec.md, ROOT-SPEC.md and initial-design.json; compared implementation and test assertions with their requirements.

Static review found role and ownership checks on application operations, owner-only roster access, and recipient checks before responses. Artist response outputs exclude backup identities. No supported authorization bypass was identified.

Selection validates revisions, capacity, duplicate candidates, request membership and previous offers. Decline and promotion share one mutation; acceptance retains the reservation and closes applications at full acceptance. Offers copy integer-cent prices without splitting. No supported backend race or partial-write defect was identified by source inspection.

CSS stacks applicants and summary at narrow widths. Ranking controls include artist names, announce changed ranks and explicitly restore focus after movement. Decline confirmation and payment-condition text are present. Browser behavior was not exercised.

SHA-256 hashes match test-baseline.json for tests/backend.test.ts, tests/images-money.test.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json and vitest.config.ts. These supplied baseline files remain byte-identical.
No browser interaction tests are supplied for T18–T20. Coverage also omits portions of the specified authorization matrix, populated-portfolio privacy checks and the 10-slot case.
No tests, typecheck, build or application sessions were executed.

limitations: Read-only source review, confined to the safe packet and the required convex-test dependency source.

Baseline-listed scripts/abacatepay-probe.mjs, scripts/abacatepay-probe.test.mjs and scripts/render-video-graphic.mjs are absent from the packet; their preservation could not be verified. This does not establish deletion from the repository.
Runtime isolation, actual Convex conflict handling, mobile rendering, keyboard behavior and assistive-technology announcements remain unverified.

No outside files, Git, environment inspection, credentials, network, collaboration, generic resource tools, connectors, account sessions or production were accessed. Denial of collaboration and generic resource routes was not verified.
